1.d4 d5 2.c4 c6 3.Nf3 e6 4.e3 Nf6 5.Nbd2.strategy: Attacks the e4-knight a second time: with the knight on d2, Nxe4 dxe4 Bxe4 would win a pawn. Black has to trade the knight or reinforce it at once.

Reinforces the knight with a pawn chain on d5, e6 and f5. The knight has a stable outpost and Black gains kingside space, at the price of a weakened e5-square and a light-squared bishop that is hemmed in behind its own pawns.
1.d4 d5 2.c4 c6 3.Nf3 e6 4.e3 Nf6 5.Nbd2.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Stonewall Variation
